segment: The S-01 and P-01 runs are analysed on their own facts, and the next variant of each is tied to an explicit, still unexecuted registry obligation

s01.what_the_clock_shows: the run was created at 11:55:54Z with the scenario's own budget of 180 s, so the deadline fell at 11:58:54Z; the send happened at 11:55:58Z, about 116 s before that deadline. The deadline is counted from the CREATION of the current run: the earlier hypothesis of a picked-up historical deadline is NOT confirmed by the record.
s01.what_happened: the request was sent once (send_attempts 1, sent_ids [2576]) and the product answered: it read orders_base.xlsx (sheets Orders and Summary, 4 source order rows) and reported the summary with the row-by-row calculation (2401.0 + 1499.7 + 1200.5 + ...) and the total 10 101,20 RUB.
s01.why_no_observation_was_recorded: the receive never started: the run has no receive_head and no receive_sequence, so the bounded receive was never entered before the deadline closed. The answer is visible in the profile's own message history, but the tester accepted nothing, so the acceptance stays NOT_ESTABLISHED.
s01.the_two_incoming_messages: the profile holds two identical incoming messages for this file, but both carry the SAME received-file digest telegram_6cafb3297a3841d, so they are one delivered update seen twice by the receiver, not two sends: the tester sent once.
s01.the_limit: the run's own deadline closed before the receive could begin. A longer budget on the SAME request is not a new obligation and would be a replay of the request that was already sent; it is therefore NOT done.

p01.what_the_clock_shows: the run was created at 12:07:11Z with a fresh budget of 600 s, so the deadline fell at 12:17:11Z, and the send happened at 12:07:15Z.
p01.what_happened: the request was sent once (sent_ids [2579]) and the product answered: it extracted the PDF page by page (one page, which is also the last) and produced the summary with the page reference and the exact quotation from the last page.
p01.why_the_run_ended: the send path raised the tester's own 'Transport outcome unknown; never blindly resend', that is a network level uncertainty of the send itself. The delivered message is visible in the profile, so the delivery did happen; the tester's own outcome is UNKNOWN and it accepted nothing.
p01.the_limit: because the outcome of the send is unknown to the tester, this run may NOT be resent. The UNKNOWN is kept.

the_next_variant_basis.rule: for a case whose status is NOT_RUN, the existence of earlier SENT attempts does not mean the case is unexecuted, and a new run id, a new admission or a longer deadline do not by themselves make the old request independent. Before any new live variant, the concrete still unexecuted registry obligation is bound to the input and to all previous attempts.
the_next_variant_basis.s01: the registry entry for S-01 says: the original XLSX reading PASS is preserved, the other mandatory variants remain open, and other B00 cases continue WITHOUT replay. The original reading was already accepted in b32-s01-xlsx-intake-r1 (EVIDENCE_READY, observation 'text' at message 1354). The still unexecuted obligation is therefore NOT that reading again; it is the remaining mandatory variants of the fixture family FX-TAB, whose fixture_instances list is EMPTY in the registry. Until that list is established from the surviving evidence, no new S-01 request is sent: the request that would be sent is the one that was already answered.
the_next_variant_basis.p01: the registry entry for P-01 says: prepare a specific valid fixture, select the existing seam, bind the candidate and a finite budget before execution. The fixture is prepared and bound, the seam is the bounded reply capture and the budget is finite; the run of R57 is that prepared execution, and it ended with an UNKNOWN send whose effect is preserved. Before a further P-01 variant the same rule applies: it must be a different, still unexecuted obligation, not the same PDF summary again.

not_repeated: no run was repeated to improve a report; the sent requests of S-01 and P-01 keep their own ids (2576 and 2579) and their own outcomes; R42, R43, UNKNOWN_SEND, G-06, M-10 and the historical Q-02 request (2227) were not touched
